mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proj_task_state_machine_revision (id, revision_no, status, effective_from, published_by, published_at, version, creator, updater, tenant_id) VALUES (#{revision.id}, #{revision.revisionNo}, 'DRAFT', #{revision.effectiveFrom}, NULL, NULL, #{revision.version}, #{revision.creator}, #{revision.updater}, #{revision.tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT revision.* FROM proj_task_state_machine_revision revision WHERE revision.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND revision.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND revision.effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt} AND revision.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY revision.revision_no DESC, revision.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM proj_task_state_transition WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND revision_id = #{query.revisionId} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY from_status_code, action_code, id FOR UPDATE
